title: Resource
description: One Maximo record serialised through an object structure. Attribute names are the MBO attributes in lower case when lean=1 (prefixed with the spi:/rdf: namespaces when lean=0); child objects appear as nested arrays/objects and related collections as {href} links. Contents depend entirely on the object structure, which is configured per installation.

href.description: Canonical URI of the record (contains the rest id).

_rowstamp.description: Optimistic-locking row stamp; send back in the If-Match header to detect concurrent updates.

doclinks.description: Link to the record's attachments collection.
